title: Bistability with equal and independent removal in small bimolecular networks
summary: We classify two-species mass-action networks with at most three internal directed reactions on $\{X,Y,2X,X+Y,2Y\}$, positive inflows, and linear removal of both species. Among the 681 networks up to species exchange, exactly 27 admit two distinct positive hyperbolic attracting equilibria. The same 27 admit bistability with equal removal rates and with independently chosen positive removal rates. Each is minimal under reaction deletion.
